observation.command:
cd /workspace && echo "=== compose ps ===" && docker compose ps --format "table {{.Name}}	{{.Status}}" && echo && echo "=== endpoint checks ===" && printf "root       : %s
" "$(curl -sS -k -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://localhost/)" && printf "admin login: %s
" "$(curl -sS -k -L -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://localhost/administration)" && printf "swagger    : %s (401 without auth: %s)
" "$(curl -sS -k -u admin:swaggerpass123 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://localhost/administration/docs/)" "$(curl -sS -k -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://localhost/administration/docs/)" && printf "measurement POST: %s
" "$(curl -sS -k -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{}' -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://localhost/api/v1/node/measurements)" && echo && echo "=== migration result ===" && docker compose logs web 2>&1 | grep -E "migrations were applied|Migrated up successfully"
